edit_boundary: Evidence packet only. No CAD, schematic, rules, queue, final invariant matrices, Library corpus, or authority decision files edited.
research_needed: No additional Researcher commission was necessary for this bounded package: indexed Library and repository authority records contain the relevant fabrication/mechanical source facts. Missing fab coupon, exact assembly, proprietary cooler, model and hardware measurements are recorded UNPROVEN rather than inferred.

invariants.statement: PiSXMe Rev A shall support the documented V100/SXM2 300 W sustained operating envelope at the product input, retaining 330 W as the design peak allowance unless a higher authoritative requirement is found.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: 300 W sustained; 330 W peak allowance; 12 V product input; with board loads and declared conversion margin
exact_provenance: Current user product decision in audit request (2026-09-14)
validation-receipts/power-envelope-authority-20260914/POWER_ENVELOPE_AUTHORITY_V1.1.md (prior 250 W basis; superseded for product envelope)
invariants.rationale: The product capability is higher-order than the existing input implementation. At 12 V and the retained 90% conversion screen, 300 W is 25.0 A before board loads and 330 W is 27.5 A before board loads.
invariants.verification_method: Power Authority signs the system envelope and validates input/copper/thermal calculations against one integrated candidate.
invariants.responsible_authority: Power Authority with Root product decision recorded
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Current exact J5/J6 assembly is documented at 8 A per circuit for the standard two-circuit 16/18-AWG application; 2 x 8 A is below the product envelope before board loads and derating. Current Branch-B copper is absent in the selected PCB.
invariants.supersession_disposition: SUPERSEDES historical 250 W DESIGN_ENVELOPE and any frozen two-circuit 8 A implementation constraint where they conflict.
invariants.notes: User product decision is binding; this packet does not redesign the input.

invariants.statement: The PCB design basis shall use the selected six-layer JLC06161H-7628 stack: nominal 1.6 mm finished board, 1 oz outer copper, 0.5 oz inner copper, with ordinary through-vias.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: 6 signal layers; 1.6 mm nominal; 0.035 mm outer copper; 0.0152 mm inner copper model; ordinary through-vias
invariants.rationale: This is the selected fabricator/material basis; it governs impedance and available layer roles.
invariants.verification_method: Parse PCB layer/setup and compare order request/coupon to the authority record.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: PCB metadata declares thickness 1.6 and six signal layers F.Cu/In1/In2/In3/In4/B.Cu; actual fabricated thickness and copper tolerance are not proven.
invariants.notes: PASS is limited to design declaration, not fabricated-board evidence.

invariants.statement: Fabrication tolerances and controlled-impedance values shall be verified with the selected fab order and coupon before release.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: 90 ohm PCIe/USB3/USB2; 100 ohm SATA/1000BASE-T; fab-returned coupon and dielectric/copper tolerances required
invariants.rationale: Calculator geometry is a design target and does not prove order-specific impedance.
invariants.verification_method: Fresh Light route census plus fab-returned coupon/field-solver result and order record.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: No current fab coupon/order package is retained; current SI acceptance row remains open.

invariants.statement: Normal routes shall meet the approved 0.20 mm trace/clearance basis; the authorized 0.10 mm fine escape is limited to the named JMS583 XIN/XOUT region and normal geometry resumes outside it.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: Normal width and clearance >=0.20 mm; JMS583 XIN/XOUT local width/clearance 0.10 mm only
invariants.rationale: Local fabrication-capable geometry is an approved exception only within a bounded component region; generic relaxation would hide manufacturability defects.
invariants.verification_method: Native DRC rule-context check, scope audit, and no out-of-window sub-0.20 mm geometry.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: The retained integrated storage evidence records U11 0.15 mm fanout outside the current authorized XIN/XOUT local rule and current DRC has width/clearance violations. The local 0.10 mm escape itself is authorized only in its named region.
invariants.supersession_disposition: SUPERSEDES any historical global 0.15/0.10 mm relaxation proposal.

invariants.statement: Ordinary through-vias and connector/package land rules shall remain within the selected fabrication and package contract: no unapproved via-in-pad in SXM2 BGA lands, covered connector-side vias where required, and package-specific drill/annular limits.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: Current ordinary via basis commonly 0.50/0.30 mm; JLC capability record includes min drill 0.15 mm, min via diameter 0.25 mm; J1 lands 0.584-0.635 mm with >=0.15 mm mask clearance and no vias in lands
invariants.rationale: Connector land/via rules are manufacturer/application constraints, while via dimensions must be checked against the actual order stack.
invariants.verification_method: Pad/via geometry parser, native DRC, package overlay, and fab capability/order review.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: J1 identity is accepted, but local mask/paste/courtyard/hidden-joint assembly overlay and complete via/DFM release are not closed.

invariants.statement: High-speed pairs shall route on outer layers over the adjacent solid GND reference planes: L1 over L2 and L6 over L5; inner-layer signal routing is excluded by the selected policy.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: L2=In1.GND; L5=In4.GND; PCIe/USB3/SATA/Ethernet targets 90/100 ohm as above
invariants.rationale: Adjacent reference continuity and geometry are required for the impedance targets; layer names alone do not prove return continuity.
invariants.verification_method: Fresh saved-geometry layer census, return-via/zone continuity audit, and extracted impedance evidence.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Layer-role declarations match the selected basis, but current return and integrated routing closure remain open.

invariants.statement: The input and protected-rail copper, vias, fuses, connectors, and returns shall be sized for PWR-ENV-001 with explicit current sharing, voltage-drop, temperature-rise, and transient margin.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: At 12 V, 300 W=25.0 A V100 load before board loads; 330 W=27.5 A before board loads; prior 90% worksheet including 22.7 W low-voltage loads gives 29.8796 A and 32.6574 A total respectively
invariants.rationale: Current capacity is a physics/safety and system-budget requirement, not a cosmetic DRC rule.
invariants.verification_method: Power Authority calculation using actual copper geometry, path resistance, source/harness, fuse I2t, connector derating, transient model and thermal model; fresh Light connectivity check.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Exact two-circuit Molex application evidence gives 8 A/circuit (16 A screen before derating), while the selected board has only 6 12V_PROTECTED segments/1 via and zero serialized Branch-B input/fused copper in the retained census. Existing 250 W/25.25 A worksheet was not a product guarantee.
invariants.supersession_disposition: SUPERSEDES implementation-derived 250 W/dual-8 A capacity assumption.

invariants.statement: Regulator and power-switch junction temperatures shall remain below the selected component operating limits under the signed current, ambient, airflow, and transient budgets.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: TPSM63606 design screen: 125 C junction limit; prior 50 C ambient/90% screen margins 19.8 C (U3), 50.7 C (U4), 71.0 C (U5); CSD19536KCS -55..175 C operating range and prior theta-JA screen
invariants.rationale: Part ratings and an analytical screen are inputs; they do not establish board-specific thermal behavior.
invariants.verification_method: Power thermal analysis with exact BOM, copper/thermal-via geometry, ambient/airflow, and fresh candidate validation; bench thermal evidence remains separate.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Existing screens are design calculations on earlier candidates; current integrated rails/Branch-B and exact capacitor DC-bias/temperature remain open.

invariants.statement: Rev A cooling shall be module-mounted air or liquid cooling on the V100/SXM2; no undocumented carrier-board cooler/backplate or generic underside keepout may be assumed.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: V100 module cooling datum retained; carrier-mounted cooler geometry unavailable; underside is available except verified board hardware/access constraints
invariants.rationale: This is the current product mechanical contract and prevents a historical soft rectangle from silently constraining copper.
invariants.verification_method: Check exact cooler/module/standoff/access evidence for release; do not treat the datum as thermal measurement.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: The contract is recorded, but no proprietary cooler model, fabricated thermal result, or complete service/access closure exists.
invariants.supersession_disposition: SUPERSEDES the former generic 150 x 95 mm carrier cooler/backplate keepout as a universal constraint.

invariants.statement: All selected connectors, mounting features, SSD envelope, SXM2 package, and service-access envelopes shall be manufacturable and mutually clear on the integrated board.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: Board envelope approximately -0.05..300.05 x -0.05..180.05 mm; J1 at (150,90); M.2 2280 envelope bbox 219.95..300.05 x 148.95..171.05 mm; J3 at (220,165); manufacturer J1 perimeter rework recommendation 5.10 mm
invariants.rationale: Physical envelope and service access can invalidate the candidate even when electrical connectivity is correct.
invariants.verification_method: Native DRC plus exact footprint/body/connector mating and assembly access review on one integrated candidate.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Current retained census reports 6 courtyard overlaps, 5 PTH-in-courtyard findings, and 16 edge-clearance findings; 128 of 131 footprints lack 3D models; release/fab/assembly artifacts are absent.

invariants.statement: Phase 24/25 release shall include a reproducible manufacturing package: Gerbers, drills, BOM, CPL, assembly drawings, panel/fab job, models and explicit dispositions.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: Required package artifacts must exist and hash to one validated integrated PCB SHA
invariants.rationale: DFM closure is an acceptance requirement, not a warning-count target.
invariants.verification_method: Fresh checkout generation, artifact hash manifest, and independent package review.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Current release audit records no Gerbers, drills, BOM/CPL, assembly drawings, panelization, or fab job in the canonical tree.

invariants.statement: Input protection shall include independently protected branches, reverse-current/reverse-polarity control, surge/TVS policy, fuse coordination, shutdown/inhibit behavior, and a declared supported source environment.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: Selected schematic families: 15 A fuse candidates, SMBJ18A candidates, LM74700-Q1 branches; regulated current-limited 12 V cold-plug boundary; no automotive load-dump claim without declared waveform/energy
invariants.rationale: Protection ratings and system policy must be proven together; fuse ampere label alone does not close I2t, thermal, or transient behavior.
invariants.verification_method: Power Authority review of exact parts/harness/source, I2t/SOA/transient calculations, fault-injection or approved simulation, and fresh validation.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: Schematic component families exist, but exact assembly, branch fault policy, transient waveform/energy, thermal path and physical Branch-B route remain open.

invariants.statement: SXM2 J1 package geometry shall follow Amphenol/FCI 74221-101LF manufacturer land, mask, orientation, via and assembly constraints; electrical unknowns remain unknown.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: 400 contacts; 10 x 40; 1.27 mm pitch; 4.0 mm mated height; 0.584..0.635 mm copper-defined lands; >=0.15 mm mask clearance; no vias in lands; 5.10 mm perimeter rework recommendation
invariants.rationale: Manufacturer package/assembly limits are foundational for manufacturability; they do not authorize electrical pin invention.
invariants.verification_method: Pad-by-pad footprint overlay, mask/paste/courtyard and hidden-joint access review against Rev W/GS-20-033.
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: J1 identity is accepted, but the retained authority explicitly says local mask/paste, A1 orientation, courtyard, hidden-joint access and full overlay remain required.

invariants.statement: Historical coordinates, generic cooler rectangles, prior trace widths and the 250 W dual-8 A input are implementation choices unless independently supported by A-D evidence.
invariants.numeric_value_or_range: No independent numeric authority; retain only as provenance and candidate history
invariants.rationale: The invariant hierarchy prevents implementation convenience from overriding product, physics, external contract or approved engineering budgets.
invariants.verification_method: At every package assignment, check referenced invariant IDs and supersession dispositions.
invariants.responsible_authority: Root Foreman with relevant domain authority
invariants.contradiction_or_evidence: No E/F historical item becomes foundational by wording such as frozen/approved/authoritative alone.
invariants.supersession_disposition: SUPERSEDED_BY_INVARIANT PWR-ENV-001 where the 250 W/dual-8 A assumption conflicts; SUPERSEDED_BY_INVARIANT THERM-MECH-001 for generic carrier cooler reservation.

recommended_work_packages.criterion: signed input/protection/distribution design satisfying 300 W sustained and 330 W peak, or evidence-backed Root escalation of a user-owned product decision
one integrated candidate with rule-context, geometry, return and impedance/coupon plan
closed body/access/model/assembly/fab package on one integrated candidate
final PROJECT_INVARIANTS and compliance matrices recorded; downstream packages reference IDs

FAB-GEO-001: U11 0.15 mm fanout is outside the named 0.10 mm JMS583 escape and normal 0.20 mm contract.
MECH-ENV-001: current integrated candidate retains courtyard/PTH/edge-clearance findings and lacks required 3D/release evidence.
